message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "R&D Acceleration", "construction": "Annual percentage change in R&D expenses (Compustat item XRD) over the last two fiscal years, divided by total assets (AT).", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly accelerating R&D spending may be investing in future growth opportunities not yet reflected in valuations.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Recent Insider Purchase Ratio", "construction": "Ratio of total shares purchased by insiders to total shares outstanding over the past 6 months (data from SEC Form 4 filings).", "rationale": "Insider purchases may signal undervaluation or positive private information about future firm prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth Reversal", "construction": "Change in total assets (AT) over the last quarter, scaled by prior quarter assets, multiplied by -1.", "rationale": "Short-term asset growth may be negatively related to future returns due to overinvestment or mean reversion.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Cash Dividend Surprise", "construction": "Actual quarterly cash dividend per share minus the average quarterly dividend over the last two years.", "rationale": "Unexpected increases in dividends may signal management's confidence about future cash flows.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Liability Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage growth in deferred tax liabilities (Compustat TXDITC) scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Rising deferred tax liabilities may indicate aggressive revenue recognition or early-stage asset growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Turnover Slope", "construction": "Slope of quarterly inventory turnover ratio (sales divided by average inventory; Compustat SALE/INVT) over the past 8 quarters.", "rationale": "Improvement in inventory management efficiency can precede better operating performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Share Repurchase Yield", "construction": "(Shares repurchased over the past year minus shares issued) divided by market capitalization.", "rationale": "Net share repurchases can signal undervaluation and shareholder-friendly capital allocation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Accounts Receivable Divergence", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in accounts receivable (RECT) minus percentage change in sales (SALE).", "rationale": "Faster growth in receivables than sales may indicate aggressive revenue recognition or collection risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Operating Lease Obligations Ratio", "construction": "Estimated present value of operating lease obligations (from footnotes) divided by total assets.", "rationale": "High off-balance-sheet obligations may signal hidden financial risk and lower-quality earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "CEO Tenure Staleness", "construction": "Number of years since the CEO assumed office (from company proxy statements).", "rationale": "Long-tenured CEOs may be less adaptive and more entrenched, potentially leading to underperformance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
